managed_start.label: Managed Start (Console)
managed_start.description: saba-runner holds the server console, so you can see its output in saba-chan. If you turn this off, the server runs as a separate process in its own window, and the saba-chan console and game chat read from it do not work. Commands go through REST, so they still work.

errors.server_not_running: Server not running. Start the server first.
errors.auth_failed: Authentication failed. Check the REST API username and password.
errors.player_not_found: Player not found. Check the nickname or SteamID.
errors.connection_refused: Server connection failed. Check the server port and REST API settings.
errors.timeout: Server response timed out. Check the server status.
errors.rest_api_disabled: REST API off. It turns on automatically at the next server start.
errors.no_executable: server_executable not set in instance settings. Add the PalServer.exe path.
errors.executable_not_found: Executable not found: {{path}}. Check the path in instance settings.
errors.no_server_dir: Server directory unknown. Set working_dir or server_executable.
errors.settings_invalid_value: Setting value has a line break or disallowed character; not saved
errors.settings_unreadable: OptionSettings line in PalWorldSettings.ini unreadable (e.g. missing closing parenthesis). File not overwritten. Fix the file and try again.
errors.rest_policy_write_failed: REST API settings could not be saved to PalWorldSettings.ini; server not started. Check file permissions and whether another program is writing to the file.
errors.settings_not_found: Settings file not found. Start the server once to generate it.
errors.player_ambiguous: Multiple players match '{{player}}': {{names}}. Be more specific.

solutions.port_in_use: Stop the other process using the port, or change the server port.
solutions.out_of_memory: Increase system memory or reduce server settings (max players, world size).
solutions.executable_crash: Verify game files in Steam, check for mod conflicts, or update the server.
solutions.save_corrupt: Restore from a backup save. Backups are in Pal/Saved/SaveGames/.
solutions.steam_auth_failed: Check that Steam is running and the steamclient libraries are accessible.

messages.using_defaults: Using DefaultPalWorldSettings.ini defaults (server not yet configured)

reset.no_path: Server directory unknown. Set working_dir or server_executable.
reset.not_found: Settings file not found. Start the server once to generate it.
reset.settings_success: Server settings reset. World data stays.
reset.settings_failed: Writing default settings to the config file failed
reset.label: Reset settings
reset.description: Restores the server settings to their defaults. The world and saves are kept.

validate.no_executable_hint: Set the path to PalServer.exe in instance settings.
